tasks.title: Create and Integrate CSS Architecture for Dark Nature Theme
tasks.description: Set up new CSS files (tokens.css, base.css, components.css, pages.css) following BEM methodology and approved design tokens.
tasks.details: Create the following files in gonzagas_node/public/css: tokens.css (define all color variables as per palette), base.css (reset, typography with Cinzel and Source Sans 3, grid system), components.css (header, footer, cards, buttons, filters), pages.css (home, catalog, PDP, vendors). Use BEM for class naming. Link all CSS files in EJS layouts. Ensure Google Fonts are loaded with font-display: swap and preload.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate that all pages render with correct colors, typography, and layout. Use browser dev tools to check CSS variables and BEM classes. Test font loading and fallback. Confirm visual compliance with approved identity.

subtasks.title: Define and Implement Design Tokens in tokens.css
subtasks.description: Create tokens.css and define all color variables and design tokens according to the approved Dark Nature palette.
subtasks.details: Set up tokens.css in gonzagas_node/public/css. Include CSS custom properties for colors, spacing, font sizes, and other design tokens. Ensure variables are named clearly and consistently for easy reference throughout the architecture.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that all variables are present and match the approved palette. Use browser dev tools to inspect variable values on sample elements.

subtasks.title: Establish Base Styles and Typography in base.css
subtasks.description: Create base.css with CSS reset, typography rules using Cinzel and Source Sans 3, and a responsive grid system.
subtasks.details: Implement a CSS reset to normalize styles. Set up font-face rules for Cinzel and Source Sans 3, ensuring Google Fonts are loaded with font-display: swap and preload. Define base typography (headings, paragraphs, links) and a grid system using CSS Grid or Flexbox. Reference design tokens for colors and spacing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that all base elements render with correct fonts and spacing. Validate grid responsiveness across breakpoints. Confirm font loading and fallback behavior.

subtasks.title: Develop Component Styles in components.css Using BEM
subtasks.description: Create components.css and implement styles for header, footer, cards, buttons, and filters using BEM class naming.
subtasks.details: Define BEM blocks for each component (e.g., .header, .footer, .card, .button, .filter) and their elements/modifiers. Use design tokens for colors and spacing. Ensure each component is modular and follows single responsibility principle. Avoid ID and tag selectors, minimize nesting, and keep selectors at single specificity level[1][2].
subtasks.testStrategy: Inspect rendered components for correct BEM class structure. Use browser dev tools to verify modularity and absence of specificity conflicts. Test component reusability on multiple pages.

subtasks.title: Implement Page-Specific Styles in pages.css Using BEM
subtasks.description: Create pages.css and add styles for home, catalog, product detail (PDP), and vendors pages using BEM methodology.
subtasks.details: Define BEM blocks for each page (e.g., .home, .catalog, .pdp, .vendors) and their unique elements/modifiers. Reference components and design tokens for consistency. Ensure page styles are scoped and do not conflict with global/component styles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render each page and verify correct application of page-specific styles. Check for visual consistency and absence of style leakage between pages.

subtasks.title: Integrate and Link CSS Files in EJS Layouts with Font Optimization
subtasks.description: Link all CSS files (tokens.css, base.css, components.css, pages.css) in EJS layouts and ensure Google Fonts are optimized.
subtasks.details: Edit EJS layout templates to include all CSS files in the correct order. Add <link rel='preload'> and font-display: swap for Google Fonts. Confirm that all pages load the CSS and fonts efficiently, with no blocking or FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content).
subtasks.testStrategy: Load each page and check for correct CSS and font application. Use browser dev tools to confirm font preloading and swap behavior. Test for performance and visual compliance.

tasks.title: Develop Main Layout and Core EJS Partials
tasks.description: Implement main-dark.ejs layout and reusable partials for header, footer, product card, and filters.
tasks.details: Create views/layouts/main-dark.ejs with Google Fonts and CSS links. Build views/partials/header-dark.ejs (navigation with links for stone types), footer-dark.ejs (3 responsive columns), card-produto.ejs (reusable product card with image, title, price, and metal/stone info), filtros.ejs (UI for filtering by stone and metal). Ensure all partials use BEM classes and are responsive.
tasks.testStrategy: Render each partial in isolation and within main-dark.ejs. Check navigation, card display, and filter UI on all breakpoints. Validate accessibility (semantic HTML, ARIA labels).

subtasks.title: Create main-dark.ejs layout with Google Fonts and CSS links
subtasks.description: Develop the main layout file (main-dark.ejs) including Google Fonts, CSS links, and EJS content placeholder.
subtasks.details: Implement views/layouts/main-dark.ejs. Add <head> section with Google Fonts and CSS links. Ensure a <body> with EJS content placeholder (<%- body %>). Use BEM class naming for layout elements. Make layout responsive using CSS grid/flexbox.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render a sample page using main-dark.ejs and verify font loading, CSS application, and responsiveness on multiple devices.

subtasks.title: Develop header-dark.ejs partial with navigation for stone types
subtasks.description: Build a reusable header partial featuring navigation links for different stone types.
subtasks.details: Create views/partials/header-dark.ejs. Implement navigation bar with links for each stone type. Use BEM classes for structure and styling. Ensure accessibility with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Make navigation responsive for mobile and desktop.
subtasks.testStrategy: Include header-dark.ejs in main-dark.ejs. Test navigation links, responsiveness, and accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA labels).

subtasks.title: Build footer-dark.ejs partial with three responsive columns
subtasks.description: Create a footer partial with three columns, ensuring responsiveness and accessibility.
subtasks.details: Develop views/partials/footer-dark.ejs. Structure footer into three columns (e.g., contact, links, social). Use BEM classes for layout. Ensure columns stack on small screens. Add semantic HTML and ARIA labels for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Include footer-dark.ejs in main-dark.ejs. Test column layout on various screen sizes and validate accessibility.

subtasks.title: Implement card-produto.ejs partial for reusable product cards
subtasks.description: Create a product card partial displaying image, title, price, and metal/stone info.
subtasks.details: Build views/partials/card-produto.ejs. Display product image, title, price, metal type, and stone info. Use BEM classes for styling. Ensure card is responsive and visually consistent. Support dynamic data via EJS variables.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render multiple card-produto.ejs instances in a sample page. Check layout, data binding, responsiveness, and accessibility (alt text, semantic tags).

subtasks.title: Create filtros.ejs partial for filtering UI by stone and metal
subtasks.description: Develop a filter UI partial allowing users to filter products by stone and metal.
subtasks.details: Implement views/partials/filtros.ejs. Add dropdowns or checkboxes for stone and metal filtering. Use BEM classes for UI elements. Ensure filter controls are accessible (labels, ARIA attributes) and responsive. Prepare for integration with filtering logic.
subtasks.testStrategy: Include filtros.ejs in main-dark.ejs. Test filter UI on all breakpoints, validate accessibility, and ensure controls are functional for future integration.

tasks.title: Implement Home Page with Dual Hero Sections
tasks.description: Create home-dark.ejs with two hero sections for Ónix and Olho-de-tigre, using approved backgrounds and responsive grid.
tasks.details: Design views/pages/home-dark.ejs with two visually distinct hero sections, each featuring background textures (ardósia, madeira negra, botânica escura), product highlights, and CTA buttons styled per palette. Ensure mobile-first grid adapts to 4/3/2 columns. Use background-attachment: scroll for mobile compatibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test rendering on mobile, tablet, desktop. Validate hero backgrounds, grid responsiveness, and CTA visibility. Check accessibility and print styles.

subtasks.title: Design Wireframes for Dual Hero Sections
subtasks.description: Create wireframes for the home-dark.ejs page, clearly outlining two visually distinct hero sections for Ónix and Olho-de-tigre, each with unique backgrounds and layout.
subtasks.details: Produce low- and high-fidelity wireframes showing placement of headlines, subheadings, product highlights, CTA buttons, and background textures (ardósia, madeira negra, botânica escura). Ensure both desktop and mobile layouts are represented, with a focus on mobile-first grid structure.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review wireframes with stakeholders for approval and alignment with brand guidelines.

subtasks.title: Implement Responsive Grid Layout in home-dark.ejs
subtasks.description: Develop the responsive grid system in home-dark.ejs to support 4/3/2 columns adapting to desktop, tablet, and mobile.
subtasks.details: Use CSS Grid or Flexbox to create a mobile-first layout that adapts to 4 columns (desktop), 3 columns (tablet), and 2 columns (mobile). Ensure grid supports hero content and product highlights. Test with various screen sizes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test grid responsiveness in browser dev tools across breakpoints; validate column count and content alignment.

subtasks.title: Integrate Approved Background Textures and Visual Styles
subtasks.description: Apply the approved background textures (ardósia, madeira negra, botânica escura) and ensure visual distinction between the two hero sections.
subtasks.details: Add background images/textures to each hero section using CSS. Ensure backgrounds are optimized for performance and use background-attachment: scroll for mobile compatibility. Apply palette-specific styles for each section.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check background rendering on all devices; verify visual distinction and performance (no layout jank or slow loads).

subtasks.title: Develop Hero Content: Headlines, Product Highlights, and CTA Buttons
subtasks.description: Implement content for each hero section, including bold headlines, product highlights, and visually prominent CTA buttons styled per palette.
subtasks.details: Insert and style headline, subheading, product highlights, and CTA buttons for Ónix and Olho-de-tigre. Use bold typography and contrasting colors for readability. Ensure CTAs are accessible and visually distinct.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate content visibility, contrast, and CTA accessibility on all devices. Confirm correct palette usage.

subtasks.title: Test and Validate Responsiveness, Accessibility, and Print Styles
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the home-dark.ejs page for responsiveness, accessibility, and print compatibility.
subtasks.details: Test rendering on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Validate hero backgrounds, grid responsiveness, and CTA visibility. Check accessibility (contrast, alt text, keyboard navigation) and print styles. Address any issues found.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use browser dev tools, accessibility checkers (axe), and manual testing to confirm all requirements are met.

tasks.title: Extend Database Schema for Product Attributes and Indexes
tasks.description: Add new fields to produtos table and create performance indexes as specified.
tasks.details: Alter produtos table to add: stone_type (ENUM), stone_origin (VARCHAR), metal_finish (ENUM), metal_purity (VARCHAR), artisan_name (VARCHAR), crafting_technique (VARCHAR), care_instructions (TEXT). Create indexes: idx_produtos_stone_type, idx_produtos_metal_finish, idx_produtos_stone_metal (composite). Use migration scripts and prepared statements for safety.
tasks.testStrategy: Run migration on test DB, verify schema changes and index creation. Insert sample data and validate queries using new fields and indexes. Check rollback capability.

subtasks.title: Design New Product Attribute Fields for produtos Table
subtasks.description: Specify the data types and constraints for each new field to be added to the produtos table.
subtasks.details: Define the following fields: stone_type (ENUM), stone_origin (VARCHAR), metal_finish (ENUM), metal_purity (VARCHAR), artisan_name (VARCHAR), crafting_technique (VARCHAR), care_instructions (TEXT). Ensure ENUM values are well-documented and VARCHAR lengths are appropriate. Confirm naming conventions follow SQL best practices (lowercase, underscores)[2].
subtasks.testStrategy: Review field definitions for correctness and adherence to naming conventions. Validate with sample CREATE TABLE statements.

subtasks.title: Create Migration Script to Alter produtos Table
subtasks.description: Develop a safe migration script to add the new fields to the produtos table using prepared statements.
subtasks.details: Write a SQL migration script that uses ALTER TABLE to add each new column. Use prepared statements to prevent SQL injection and ensure transactional safety. Include comments for rollback instructions and versioning.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run migration on a test database, verify schema changes, and check rollback capability.

subtasks.title: Implement Indexes for Performance Optimization
subtasks.description: Create the specified indexes on the produtos table to improve query performance.
subtasks.details: Add single-column indexes: idx_produtos_stone_type (on stone_type), idx_produtos_metal_finish (on metal_finish), and a composite index idx_produtos_stone_metal (on stone_type, metal_finish). Ensure index names follow conventions and avoid redundancy[1].
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify index creation via database metadata queries. Benchmark query performance before and after index addition.

subtasks.title: Validate Schema and Index Changes with Sample Data
subtasks.description: Insert representative sample data and test queries to ensure new fields and indexes function as intended.
subtasks.details: Populate produtos table with sample records using new fields. Execute queries filtering and sorting by new attributes. Confirm indexes are utilized by examining query execution plans.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use EXPLAIN plans to confirm index usage. Validate data integrity and query results.

subtasks.title: Document Migration, Indexes, and Rollback Procedures
subtasks.description: Prepare comprehensive documentation covering schema changes, index creation, and rollback steps.
subtasks.details: Write documentation detailing the new fields, their data types, ENUM values, index definitions, and migration steps. Include rollback instructions and testing outcomes. Ensure documentation is clear for future maintenance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and clarity. Validate rollback steps on a test database.

tasks.title: Develop Catalog Controller and Filtering Logic
tasks.description: Create catalogoController.js to handle product listing, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
tasks.details: Implement catalogoController.js with Express route handlers for GET /catalogo. Parse query params for pedra, metal, ordenar, and page. Build SQL queries using prepared statements for filtering and sorting. Implement pagination (12 products/page). Ensure modular code structure (controllers, routes, models).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test controller methods for all filter/sort/pagination combinations. Validate SQL queries for correctness and performance. Test error handling and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Set Up catalogoController.js and Express Route Handler
subtasks.description: Create the catalogoController.js file and define the Express route handler for GET /catalogo.
subtasks.details: Create catalogoController.js in the controllers directory. In this file, export a function to handle GET requests to /catalogo. In the routes file, import this controller and set up the route using Express Router. Ensure the controller is modular and follows Express best practices for separation of concerns.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that GET /catalogo returns a response and the controller is correctly invoked by the route.

subtasks.title: Implement Filtering, Sorting, and Pagination Logic
subtasks.description: Parse query parameters (pedra, metal, ordenar, page) and build SQL queries using prepared statements for filtering, sorting, and pagination.
subtasks.details: Within the controller, extract query parameters from req.query. Construct SQL queries using prepared statements to filter by pedra and metal, sort by the ordenar parameter, and paginate results (12 products per page). Use a model layer to interact with the database, ensuring all queries are secure and efficient.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test the controller with various combinations of query parameters. Validate that the correct SQL is generated and the expected products are returned for each scenario.

subtasks.title: Ensure Modular Code Structure and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Refactor code to maintain a modular structure (controllers, routes, models) and implement robust error handling.
subtasks.details: Organize code so that business logic resides in the controller, database access in the model, and routing in the routes file. Add error handling for invalid parameters, database errors, and edge cases. Ensure the controller returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test error scenarios such as invalid query parameters, database failures, and empty result sets. Confirm that errors are handled gracefully and the API responds with correct status codes and messages.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Page with Functional Filters and Pagination
tasks.description: Build catalogo-dark.ejs with product grid, filter UI, and pagination controls.
tasks.details: Design views/pages/catalogo-dark.ejs to display products in a responsive grid. Integrate filtros.ejs for filtering by stone and metal. Add sorting dropdown and pagination controls. Ensure query params are preserved in URLs. Use card-produto.ejs for product display.
tasks.testStrategy: Test filtering, sorting, and pagination in browser. Validate URL query params and navigation. Check grid responsiveness and accessibility.

subtasks.title: Design Responsive Product Grid in catalogo-dark.ejs
subtasks.description: Create a responsive grid layout in catalogo-dark.ejs to display products using card-produto.ejs for each item, ensuring the grid adapts to different screen sizes.
subtasks.details: Implement a CSS grid or flexbox layout in catalogo-dark.ejs that dynamically adjusts the number of columns based on viewport width. Integrate card-produto.ejs as the template for each product card, ensuring consistent styling and accessibility. Test across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify grid responsiveness by resizing the browser window and checking on multiple devices. Ensure product cards render correctly and maintain alignment.

subtasks.title: Integrate Filter UI with filtros.ejs for Stone and Metal
subtasks.description: Embed the filtros.ejs component into catalogo-dark.ejs to enable filtering products by stone and metal attributes.
subtasks.details: Include filtros.ejs within catalogo-dark.ejs, ensuring the filter controls are visually cohesive with the page design. Connect the filter UI to the product data so selections dynamically update the displayed products. Preserve filter state in the URL query parameters for shareable links.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each filter option to confirm only matching products are shown. Check that filter state is reflected and preserved in the URL. Verify that page reloads restore the correct filtered view.

subtasks.title: Add Product Sorting Dropdown Control
subtasks.description: Implement a dropdown UI element in catalogo-dark.ejs that allows users to sort products by relevant criteria (e.g., price, name).
subtasks.details: Design and integrate a sorting dropdown that triggers client-side reordering of the product grid. Ensure the selected sort option is included in the URL query parameters for consistent navigation. Update the product grid instantly upon sort selection.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each sort option to confirm the product grid updates correctly. Validate that the sort parameter is preserved in the URL and survives page reloads.

subtasks.title: Implement Pagination Controls with Preserved Query Params
subtasks.description: Add pagination controls to catalogo-dark.ejs, allowing users to navigate through product pages while maintaining all active filters and sort options in the URL.
subtasks.details: Develop pagination UI (previous/next buttons, page numbers) that updates the product grid without full page reloads where possible. Ensure all active filters, sort options, and the current page are encoded in the URL query parameters. Handle edge cases (e.g., empty result sets, last page).
subtasks.testStrategy: Navigate through pagination controls to verify products update correctly. Check that URL query params reflect the current page and all active filters/sorts. Test behavior with filtered or sorted results.

subtasks.title: Ensure URL Query Param Consistency Across All Interactions
subtasks.description: Guarantee that every user interaction (filtering, sorting, pagination) updates and preserves the correct URL query parameters for shareable, bookmarkable, and reload-safe catalog views.
subtasks.details: Implement logic to synchronize the URL query parameters with the current catalog state after any filter, sort, or pagination action. Ensure the page can be reloaded or shared with others while retaining the exact product view. Use JavaScript to manage URL updates without unnecessary page reloads where possible.
subtasks.testStrategy: After each interaction (filter, sort, paginate), check that the URL updates correctly. Reload the page or copy the URL to another browser tab to confirm the catalog state is restored accurately. Test with various combinations of filters, sorts, and pages.

tasks.title: Create Product Detail Page with Storytelling and Gallery
tasks.description: Implement produto-dark.ejs to show product details, gallery, and 'Origem da Matéria' storytelling.
tasks.details: Build views/pages/produto-dark.ejs to display product info: stone scientific name, origin, metal type/purity, artisan name, crafting technique, care instructions. Add image gallery with thumbnails and lazy loading. Use Open Graph meta tags and SEO best practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Test rendering for products with/without all fields. Validate gallery functionality, lazy loading, and meta tags. Check accessibility and print styles.

subtasks.title: Design EJS Template Structure for Product Detail Page
subtasks.description: Create the initial produto-dark.ejs file structure to display all required product fields and sections.
subtasks.details: Set up views/pages/produto-dark.ejs with placeholders for stone scientific name, origin, metal type/purity, artisan name, crafting technique, care instructions, and 'Origem da Matéria' storytelling. Use semantic HTML and ensure logical sectioning for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render the template with mock data to verify all sections appear and are structured correctly.

subtasks.title: Implement Dynamic Data Rendering in EJS Template
subtasks.description: Integrate EJS logic to render product details dynamically based on data passed from the controller.
subtasks.details: Use EJS scriptlet tags to output product fields and conditionally render sections if data is missing. Ensure all product attributes are displayed using EJS syntax and handle cases where some fields may be undefined.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with products having full and partial data. Confirm correct rendering and absence of errors for missing fields.

subtasks.title: Develop Image Gallery with Thumbnails and Lazy Loading
subtasks.description: Add an interactive image gallery to the template, supporting thumbnails and lazy loading for performance.
subtasks.details: Implement a gallery section using HTML and JavaScript. Display main image and clickable thumbnails. Use the 'loading="lazy"' attribute for images. Ensure gallery is accessible and works on mobile and desktop.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify gallery displays all images, thumbnails switch main image, and lazy loading works by monitoring network requests.

subtasks.title: Integrate Storytelling Section ('Origem da Matéria')
subtasks.description: Implement the storytelling section to narrate the origin and crafting story of the product.
subtasks.details: Add a dedicated section in the template for 'Origem da Matéria', rendering narrative content from product data. Style for readability and ensure it fits the overall page design.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that the storytelling section displays correctly for products with and without narrative content.

subtasks.title: Add Open Graph Meta Tags and SEO Enhancements
subtasks.description: Implement Open Graph meta tags and other SEO best practices in the EJS template.
subtasks.details: Insert dynamic meta tags for title, description, and images using EJS. Ensure meta tags reflect product details and gallery images. Add semantic HTML, alt attributes, and check for accessibility and print styles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use browser dev tools and SEO analyzers to verify meta tags, accessibility, and print styles. Confirm Open Graph tags populate correctly for each product.

tasks.title: Prepare Multi-Vendor Page and Base Controller
tasks.description: Create vendedores.ejs and baseController.js for future multi-vendor support and shared view data.
tasks.details: Design views/pages/vendedor.ejs with placeholder vendor info and responsive layout. Implement baseController.js to provide common data (site identity, navigation, etc.) to all views. Ensure extensibility for future multi-vendor features.
tasks.testStrategy: Render vendedores.ejs and validate layout. Test baseController.js data injection in multiple views. Check for future extensibility.

subtasks.title: Design vendedores.ejs with Placeholder Vendor Information
subtasks.description: Create the initial vendedores.ejs template with placeholder data for a single vendor, ensuring a responsive layout.
subtasks.details: Develop views/pages/vendedores.ejs using EJS. Include sections for vendor name, description, and sample product listings. Use placeholder data and ensure the layout adapts to different screen sizes. Structure the template for easy extension to multiple vendors in the future.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render vendedores.ejs in the browser and verify that all placeholder data displays correctly and the layout is responsive on desktop and mobile.

subtasks.title: Implement baseController.js for Shared View Data
subtasks.description: Create baseController.js to inject common data (site identity, navigation, etc.) into all views.
subtasks.details: Develop controllers/baseController.js to provide shared data such as site title, navigation links, and branding. Use middleware to attach this data to res.locals for access in all EJS templates. Follow modular and extensible coding practices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test baseController.js to ensure it correctly attaches shared data to res.locals. Render multiple views and confirm shared data is available.

subtasks.title: Integrate baseController.js with Express Routing
subtasks.description: Apply baseController.js middleware to relevant Express routes to ensure shared data is available in all views.
subtasks.details: Update the Express app configuration to use baseController.js as middleware for all routes rendering EJS views. Ensure that any new or existing routes for vendor pages utilize this middleware.
subtasks.testStrategy: Access various routes and verify that shared data from baseController.js appears in the rendered views.

subtasks.title: Prepare vendedores.ejs for Future Multi-Vendor Support
subtasks.description: Refactor vendedores.ejs to support dynamic rendering of multiple vendors using an array of vendor data.
subtasks.details: Modify vendedores.ejs to iterate over a vendors array and render each vendor's information. Update the controller logic to pass a sample array of vendor objects to the view. Ensure the template structure is flexible for future enhancements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Pass multiple vendor objects to vendedores.ejs and verify that all vendors are rendered correctly and the layout remains responsive.

subtasks.title: Document Extensibility and Usage for Future Multi-Vendor Features
subtasks.description: Write documentation explaining how to extend vendedores.ejs and baseController.js for future multi-vendor features.
subtasks.details: Create a markdown file or code comments detailing how to add new vendor fields, extend shared data in baseController.js, and integrate additional multi-vendor logic. Include examples and best practices for maintainability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for clarity and completeness. Have another developer follow the instructions to verify they can extend the functionality as described.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance, SEO, and Accessibility
tasks.description: Implement lazy loading, compression, cache headers, meta tags, Open Graph, and accessibility improvements.
tasks.details: Add loading="lazy" to all images. Integrate middleware compression (gzip/brotli) in Express. Set cache headers for static assets (7d for CSS, 30d for images). Add meta tags and Open Graph tags in EJS layouts. Ensure AA contrast, semantic labels, alt text, reduce motion, and keyboard navigation. Preload critical fonts.
tasks.testStrategy: Use GTmetrix and PageSpeed Insights for performance. Validate meta tags and Open Graph with browser tools. Test accessibility with axe and manual checks. Confirm cache headers via network inspector.

subtasks.title: Implement Performance Optimizations
subtasks.description: Apply technical optimizations to improve page load speed, reduce bandwidth usage, and enhance user experience.
subtasks.details: Add loading='lazy' to all images to defer offscreen image loading. Integrate Express middleware for gzip and Brotli compression to reduce transfer size. Set cache headers for static assets: 7 days for CSS, 30 days for images. Preload critical fonts using <link rel='preload'>. Minimize and combine CSS/JS files, and remove unused code. Use CDN for global asset delivery if not already in place. Test with GTmetrix and PageSpeed Insights for performance metrics and identify bottlenecks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use GTmetrix and PageSpeed Insights to measure load times and identify optimization opportunities. Verify cache headers and compression via browser network inspector. Confirm font preloading and lazy loading behavior.

subtasks.title: Enhance SEO and Social Sharing
subtasks.description: Improve search engine visibility and social media sharing by adding and optimizing meta tags and Open Graph markup.
subtasks.details: Add comprehensive meta tags (title, description, keywords, viewport) and Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, etc.) in EJS layout files. Ensure all pages have unique, descriptive titles and descriptions. Validate markup with browser developer tools and social media debuggers. Consider schema.org markup for rich snippets if relevant. Keep URLs clean and semantic, especially for catalog filters and pagination.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate meta and Open Graph tags using browser dev tools and Facebook/Twitter sharing debuggers. Check for uniqueness and accuracy across pages. Test URL structure for SEO-friendliness.

subtasks.title: Upgrade Accessibility Compliance
subtasks.description: Ensure the website meets AA contrast standards, is fully navigable by keyboard, and provides a robust experience for users with disabilities.
subtasks.details: Audit and enforce AA color contrast ratios for all text and interactive elements. Use semantic HTML5 elements and ARIA labels where appropriate. Ensure all images have descriptive alt text. Implement 'prefers-reduced-motion' media queries to respect user motion preferences. Test and fix keyboard navigation for all interactive elements, including filters and pagination. Remove or fix any accessibility violations identified by automated and manual testing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with axe-core and manual checks for WCAG AA compliance. Verify keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility. Check color contrast with tools like WebAIM Contrast Checker. Confirm reduced-motion support and proper alt text on images.

tasks.title: Deploy to Production and Final Validation
tasks.description: Deploy refactored site to Dominios.pt, validate on real devices, and document changes.
tasks.details: Deploy incrementally to cPanel/Dominios.pt after client approval. Test site on Android/iOS devices for responsiveness and performance. Validate HTML/CSS with W3C validator. Update README with deployment steps and changes. Ensure rollback plan and client sign-off.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform smoke tests on production. Validate on multiple devices and browsers. Check deployment logs and rollback capability. Confirm documentation completeness.

subtasks.title: Obtain Client Approval for Deployment
subtasks.description: Secure explicit sign-off from the client before initiating any deployment to production.
subtasks.details: Communicate deployment plan and schedule to the client. Confirm all changes are reviewed and approved. Document approval (e.g., email confirmation).

subtasks.title: Incremental Deployment to cPanel/Dominios.pt
subtasks.description: Deploy the refactored site incrementally to the production environment.
subtasks.details: Use cPanel to upload and replace site files in batches. Monitor deployment logs for errors. Ensure database updates (if any) are applied safely. Maintain a rollback plan with clear steps to revert if issues arise.
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform smoke tests on production after each deployment batch. Verify critical user journeys. Check deployment logs for errors.

subtasks.title: Cross-Device and Cross-Browser Validation
subtasks.description: Test the deployed site on real Android and iOS devices, and major browsers.
subtasks.details: Access the live site on a range of devices (phones, tablets) and browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Check for responsiveness, layout integrity, touch interactions, and performance. Document any device-specific issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate rendering, navigation, and core functionality across all target devices and browsers. Note discrepancies and prioritize fixes.

subtasks.title: W3C HTML/CSS Validation and Accessibility Check
subtasks.description: Validate all pages using the W3C Markup and CSS Validators to ensure standards compliance.
subtasks.details: Submit the production site URL to the W3C HTML and CSS validators. Review all errors and warnings. Fix markup issues (e.g., unclosed tags, missing alt attributes) and CSS errors. Ensure semantic HTML and ARIA labels are used correctly for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Revalidate after each fix. Confirm zero critical errors. Spot-check accessibility with screen readers if possible.

subtasks.title: Update Documentation and Finalize Rollback Plan
subtasks.description: Document deployment steps, changes, and ensure a tested rollback procedure is in place.
subtasks.details: Update the project README with detailed deployment instructions, notable changes, and any post-deployment notes. Finalize and test the rollback plan. Obtain final client sign-off confirming the site is live and validated.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review documentation for completeness and accuracy. Simulate rollback to confirm it works as expected. Confirm client acceptance.
